title: epic: generated documentation as corpus material
description:
Doc generation as a mount-time preprocessor: turn a code repo into a Markdown repo so the existing extract/author/browse pipeline works unchanged. Plan: ~/.claude/plans/cheerful-percolating-lemon.md

Four decisions taken with the user: substrate-only (no web/ changes, manifest stays v6); container-only with no host fallback (determinism drives content_hash); four toolchains (TS, Python, Go, C/C++); one material per register via a new translation.yaml 'material:' key.
design: Derived trees live at corpora/<name>/derived/<recipe>/, git init-ed so gittree.py treats them as ordinary checkouts. The adapter contract is unchanged - it still receives exactly one root. New machinery is confined to getting the tree onto disk: recipe schema, container runner, census, normalizer, a ch:docgen-planner subagent, and a GATE M in /ch:mount.

title: docgen p2: ./ch doc CLI verb
description: Added to _parser() (__main__.py:85-202) and dispatch (:332+). --census (writes nothing) / --stage --from <recipe.json> (writes .staging/<recipe>/) / --promote (writes derived/<recipe>/ + git init+commit) / --status (nothing) / --clean (deletes staging, explicit yes). --from mirrors ./ch set --from: the agent writes JSON, the CLI validates and owns the write. Exit 2 for errors (Docker absent, pull failed, non-deterministic output), 1 for --status drift. --stage on an unverified recipe runs twice and diffs, stamping determinism.verified plus its digest on success.

title: docgen p2: runner.py - the docker invocation
description: tools/lingua/docgen/runner.py, stdlib subprocess only (no docker SDK) matching the three-runtime-dep posture and the gittree.py precedent (argv list, never shell=True). docker run --rm --network none --user <uid>:<gid> --read-only --mount type=bind,src=<source>,dst=/src,ro --mount type=bind,src=<staging>,dst=/out --tmpfs /tmp --memory 2g --cpus 2 --pids-limit 512 <image@sha256:...> <tool>. --rm is the destroy half of instantiate/run/destroy; --network none means a generator cannot fetch deps mid-run; the ro source bind makes 'never modify corpora/*/source/' the kernel's job.
